tasks.subject: Task 1: Ephemeral monsterNames state + resolution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** DnDBeyondPanel holds an ephemeral name override per monster instance, resolves it into the broadcast name, exposes applyMonsterName/resetMonsterName, and clears the map on encounter switch / stop.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/views/DnDBeyondPanel.ts
- Create: src/__tests__/ddb-panel-rename.test.ts

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/views/DnDBeyondPanel.ts", "src/__tests__/ddb-panel-rename.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "make test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["monsterNames cleared on select/stop", "broadcast uses override name with no renamed/originalName fields", "PreviewCombatant has originalName+renamed", "applyMonsterName empty=noop equal=reset else=set"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Cut the beta and verify with the user
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Open the PR, cut a -beta.N prerelease for BRAT, get user confirmation it works in their vault.

**Files:**
- Modify: manifest.json, package.json, package-lock.json (bump to 0.20.0-beta.1)

**User Verification Required:** call AskUserQuestion (Funciona / Hay un problema). If problem: NOT complete — rework, re-cut beta, re-verify.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["manifest.json", "package.json", "package-lock.json"], "verifyCommand": "git ls-remote --tags origin 'v0.20.0-beta*'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["version files bumped to 0.20.0-beta.1", "prerelease published", "PR open with release:minor", "user confirms"], "requiresUserVerification": true, "userVerificationPrompt": "La beta está publicada. ¿Funciona el rename y el modal de condiciones en tu vault?"}
```
